environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALBv2 with AWS WAFv2 WebACL attached. WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode (overridden), (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' at priority 200 containing a regex pattern set match on the 'q' query string parameter that blocks requests where the decoded query string value matches pattern ['";\-\-]|UNION|SELECT|INSERT|DROP|UPDATE|DELETE|EXEC|CAST|CONVERT (case-insensitive, text transformation: URL_DECODE, HTML_ENTITY_DECODE, LOWERCASE), action BLOCK, (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in BLOCK mode with no rule overrides. WAFv2 logging enabled to CloudWatch Logs with full request headers captured. ALB access logs enabled to S3.

config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
